bob_k: any chance this was introduced by the dep bump from yesterday? :thinking:

sasha: looks like eslint rule is strict now. I can push a quick fix to rc2-hotfix branch, but should we pause canary rollout until we have green? :eyes:

tim: +1 pause. don't promote to full prod until we confirm. We should also consider pinning the lint config in CI to avoid flapping.

devops-oncall: noting incident tag: REL-2026-118. I'll hold the rollout and disable automated promote-for-green.

alice.chen: I'll open rc2-hotfix and run only lint step locally, will push in ~15m.

bob_k: if hotfix is tiny we can re-run lint job instead of full rebuild: `/ci retry lint-js` works.

release-manager: decision: hold canary, create hotfix branch, aim for re-run within 30m. No rollback needed since this is pre-promote. Communicating to stakeholders.
